description: This file contains tests for memory core index module, including functions buildMemoryFlushPlan and buildPromptSection, as well as constants related to memory flushing. It uses testing frameworks like vitest and mocks external modules.

methods.name: buildMemoryFlushPlan
methods.description: Generates a plan for memory data flushing, including prompt content, system prompt, and related configuration based on provided config and current time.

methods.name: buildPromptSection
methods.description: Constructs a prompt section related to memory tools available, guiding the user on how to recall memory or indicating disabled citations mode.

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^    const result = buildPromptSection({ availableTools: new Set(["memory_get"]) });$/

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^    const result = buildPromptSection({ availableTools: new Set(["memory_search"]) });$/
